answer.sql: WITH "cohort" AS (SELECT "b"."device_id" AS "device_id", "o"."paid_date" AS "paid_date", "p"."product_name" AS "product_name" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "i" ON "o"."order_id" = "i"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "b" ON "i"."item_id" = "b"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "d" ON "b"."device_id" = "d"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "p" ON "d"."product_id" = "p"."product_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "outcomes" AS (SELECT "c"."device_id" AS "device_id", "c"."product_name" AS "product_name", CASE WHEN NOT "a"."device_id" IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "is_activated" FROM "cohort" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "fact_device_activation" AS "a" ON "c"."device_id" = "a"."device_id" AND "a"."activation_date" >= "c"."paid_date" AND "a"."activation_date" <= "c"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAYS) SELECT "outcomes"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "outcomes"."device_id") AS "devices", SUM("outcomes"."is_activated") AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "outcomes"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(SUM("outcomes"."is_activated") * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "outcomes"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "outcomes" AS "outcomes" GROUP BY "outcomes"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

answer.question: 按产品型号看2026年9月我权限内售出设备的30天售后设备率。只取成熟队列，含退款设备；多次报修按一台设备计，列出设备分母、售后分子、百分数。
answer.sql: WITH "cohort" AS (SELECT "dp"."product_name" AS "product_name", "bod"."device_id" AS "device_id", "fo"."paid_date" AS "paid_date" FROM "fact_order" AS "fo" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "foi" ON "fo"."order_id" = "foi"."order_id" JOIN "bridge_order_device" AS "bod" ON "foi"."item_id" = "bod"."item_id" JOIN "dim_device" AS "dd" ON "bod"."device_id" = "dd"."device_id" JOIN "dim_product" AS "dp" ON "dd"."product_id" = "dp"."product_id" WHERE "fo"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-09-01' AS DATE) AND "fo"."paid_date" <= CAST('2026-09-16' AS DATE)), "outcomes" AS (SELECT "c"."product_name" AS "product_name", "c"."device_id" AS "device_id", "c"."paid_date" AS "paid_date", MIN("fst"."created_date") AS "first_service_date" FROM "cohort" AS "c" LEFT JOIN "fact_service_ticket" AS "fst" ON "c"."device_id" = "fst"."device_id" AND "fst"."created_date" BETWEEN "c"."paid_date" AND "c"."paid_date" + INTERVAL '30' DAYS GROUP BY "c"."product_name", "c"."device_id", "c"."paid_date") SELECT "outcomes"."product_name" AS "product_name", COUNT(DISTINCT "outcomes"."device_id") AS "devices", COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "outcomes"."first_service_date" IS NULL THEN "outcomes"."device_id" END) AS "matched_devices", CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT "outcomes"."device_id") = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN NOT "outcomes"."first_service_date" IS NULL THEN "outcomes"."device_id" END) * 100.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT "outcomes"."device_id"), 2) END AS "rate_percent" FROM "outcomes" AS "outcomes" GROUP BY "outcomes"."product_name" ORDER BY "product_name" LIMIT 1001

answer.question: 请按渠道名称统计2026年7月我权限范围内的净销售额，退款扣回原支付月份，不是按退款发生月份记账。
answer.sql: SELECT "c"."channel_name" AS "channel_name", SUM("oi"."amount" - COALESCE("r"."refund_amount", 0)) AS "net_sales" FROM "fact_order" AS "o" JOIN "dim_channel" AS "c" ON "o"."channel_id" = "c"."channel_id" JOIN "fact_order_item" AS "oi" ON "o"."order_id" = "oi"."order_id" LEFT JOIN (SELECT "fact_refund"."item_id" AS "item_id", SUM("fact_refund"."amount") AS "refund_amount" FROM "fact_refund" AS "fact_refund" GROUP BY "fact_refund"."item_id") AS "r" ON "oi"."item_id" = "r"."item_id" WHERE "o"."paid_date" >= CAST('2026-07-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."paid_date" < CAST('2026-08-01' AS DATE) AND "o"."status" = '已支付' GROUP BY "c"."channel_name" LIMIT 1001
